info.title: SanitasLink API
info.description: Identity, office (tenant) and authorization APIs. The tenant is always derived from the authenticated JWT; no X-Office-Id header is used or accepted.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Platform administration of offices, members and catalogs

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Login, token lifecycle, invitation acceptance and password management

tags.name: Office
tags.description: Office information, staff management and invitations

post.summary: Invite a collaborator to the office
Rotate the refresh token and obtain a new access token
post.description: Reads the refresh token from the HttpOnly cookie (no request body). Authenticates through the refresh cookie: no bearer header is used.

post.summary: Change the password of the authenticated user
Request a password reset (uniform response, no account enumeration)
Confirm a password reset with the one-time token
Revoke the refresh token from the HttpOnly cookie
post.description: Reads the refresh token from the HttpOnly cookie (no request body) and expires it. Authenticates through the refresh cookie: no bearer header is used.

post.summary: Login and obtain an access token
post.description: Sets the refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth. Authenticates through the refresh cookie: the client must send credentials cookies (withCredentials) and no bearer header.

post.summary: Accept an office invitation and set the first-access password
Provision a new office with its titular doctor

get.summary: List the active members of an office

post.summary: Provision a collaborator into an office

patch.summary: Assign an office role to a member
Transition an appointment to a new status

get.summary: Current user profile with effective roles and permissions

delete.summary: Remove a member from the office
Revoke an office role from a member

cookieAuth.name: sl_refresh
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly refresh-token cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth. The raw refresh token never appears in response bodies; it is rotated on every refresh and issued/cleared through Set-Cookie. Secure and SameSite=Strict outside the local dev profile.
